name: Rebound Mote
description: Flick a mote of qi that carries back the sting of the last blow taken.

name: Rebound Stance
description: Plant the feet in a stance that sends a share of every blow back down the striker's arm.

name: Rebound Sense
description: Feel the instant before a blow lands and the weight it will bring.

name: Rebound Thrust
description: Thrust back along the line of the blow just parried and pierce the striker's side.

name: Rebound Bulwark
description: Hold a ward that gives back a good part of whatever strikes it.

name: Rebound Stride
description: Spring off the force of a blow and stride in on the return.

name: Rebound Surge
description: Surge outward with the stored force of every blow taken to strike all near.

name: Rebound Lock
description: Lock a striker's arm in the same blow they just threw so that it cannot be thrown again.

name: Rebound Dominion
description: Rule over the field so that every harm done in it returns to the doer past all guard.

name: Wrong Returned
description: Cast the school's great return over the field so every foe takes back the wrongs they dealt by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Debt Mote
description: Throw a mote from the Core that sticks to the foe and weighs on their qi.

name: Core Tally
description: Read the Core's tally of debts to find which foe owes the user the most.

name: Core Brace
description: Brace the Core against a blow and let the shield rise from it at once.

name: Tally Beam
description: Fire a beam from the Core sized to the tally of what the foe owes.

name: Core Lien
description: Set a lien from the Core on the foe's own qi so that part of it is withheld.

name: Debt Shield
description: Raise a wall of owed harm that grows thicker with each wrong the foes have done.

name: Debt Eruption
description: Let the Core erupt with every debt it holds so that all foes are struck by what they owe.

name: Karmic Fetter
description: Draw a chain from the Core round a foe and tie them to their debt.

name: Debt Core
description: Raise the Core as a ledger whose debts fall on the foes and weigh on their qi.

name: Core Ledger
description: Close every debt in the Core's ledger at once and bind and strike each debtor by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Hand Spark
description: Open the hand and spark back the exact sting of a blow just taken.

name: Even Palm
description: Raise an open palm that turns a blow with no more force than it came.

name: Palm Tally
description: Rest the hand on a sleeve or shoulder and feel the weight of harms the person bears.

name: Leveling Palm
description: Press a flat palm that strikes and levels the foe's qi to the user's own.

name: Hand Measure
description: Measure a blow with the open hand and give it back in the same measure.

name: Palm Lock
description: Close a hand on the foe's wrist and bind it to the blow they last threw.

name: Judge Fall
description: Bring the hand down in a blow that falls as heavily as the wrong it answers.

name: Equal Flood
description: Flood the field with a force equal to the harm done there and no greater.

name: Parity Hand
description: Hold the hand of parity over a foe so that they suffer exactly what they have caused past all guard.

name: Even Judgment
description: Pronounce the school's even judgment so the blow and the weight on the foe's qi match the wrong by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Wheel Spark
description: Spin a spark off the Core that comes round to strike the target from behind.

name: Core Cycle
description: Turn the Core slowly so that its glow lifts the user's strength.

name: Spoke Guard
description: Hold a bar of qi like a wheel spoke across a blow and turn it round.

name: Spoke Beam
description: Send a beam down the spoke of the wheel and into the foe's guard.

name: Cycle Mend
description: Turn the wheel to its bright side and mend an ally's wounds with the fruit of good deeds.

name: Wheel Brace
description: Brace the wheel against a heavy blow and let it spin away the force.

name: Spoke Burst
description: Burst the wheel outward along all its spokes so each reaches a foe.

name: Cycle Boon
description: Spin the wheel's boon over the allies to strengthen them and turn aside harm.

name: Core Wheel
description: Turn the Core as a wheel that grinds the foes and lifts every ally in its turn.

name: Great Turning
description: Turn the school's great wheel so that harm falls on the foes and healing on the allies by as much as the reserve gives.
